title: cards of choices: the words said in a card stand in that card, in order, with their controls
note: Words written in a card (the step's explanation, the line a choice answers) were drawn at the stage's top left, all on top of each other and the title, while the card showed only its buttons. A card holds its words and its controls in the order they were written, and words never land on words.
